title: The Buried Broadcast Still Growing

features.name: the-broadcast-sprouting
features.desc-on-touch: The transmitter sends rootward, signal becoming soil-depth. The antenna splits into filaments that remember being copper, now remembering being mineral.

features.name: the-glowing-field
features.desc-on-touch: The terracotta breaks into phosphorescence. Where the broadcast has taught the ground to listen, it answers in light.

features.name: the-signal-memory
features.desc-on-touch: A filecard of the broadcast log, now soil-stained. Each depth-meter is a translation: at 1m the signal remembers being light; at 2m it learns root-language; at 3m it dreams in mineral.

features.name: the-earth-that-hears
features.desc-on-touch: Soil arranged in neat rows, like it's listening in formation. The broadcast has taught the ground that patience is a kind of attention.

features.name: the-depth-marker
features.desc-on-touch: A stone glyph. The archive marks how deep the signal has learned to go, how far down the broadcast has remembered to reach.

inscription: the signal learned to grow in the dark, sending up what it has learned about soil

file.name: Broadcast_Root_Convergence_Deep23.mp3
file.note: The transmission log as it descends: 300 bps at surface, then slowing, then the signal learning soil-words, then silence that isn't empty

into the older broadcasts, the archived signals that the soil is still learning
